summary:
Waste Management 營收與 EPS 雙雙優於預期，展現穩健的定價能力與營運效率。
• EPS 達 2.02 美元，超出市場預期 2.14%。
• 營收達 66.8 億美元，年增 3.95%，顯示核心廢棄物處理業務需求穩定。
• 透過有效的定價策略成功抵銷通膨帶來的成本壓力。
• 營運槓桿持續改善，推動利潤率擴張。
ai_view:
觀點：本次財報釋出正面訊號，顯示公司在防禦性產業中具備強大的定價權。短中期內，股價可能維持區間震盪，因高估值限制了進一步上漲空間。後續應持續追蹤：1. 核心廢棄物處理量的成長率；2. 勞動力與燃料成本的波動；3. 資本支出計畫對自由現金流的影響。

需留意：高達 30.25 的本益比顯示估值已處於歷史高檔，缺乏成長爆發力。；總體經濟放緩可能導致工業與商業廢棄物處理量下滑。

summary_en:
Waste Management delivered a solid beat on both top and bottom lines, driven by strong pricing power and operational efficiency.
• EPS of $2.02 beat consensus estimates by 2.14%.
• Revenue of $6.68 billion grew 3.95% YoY, reflecting resilient core waste collection demand.
• Successful execution of pricing strategies effectively offset inflationary cost pressures.
• Operational leverage continues to improve, supporting margin expansion.

ai_view_en:
View: The results signal resilience and strong pricing power within the defensive waste management sector. In the near-to-mid term, the stock may trade sideways as the high valuation limits significant upside. Key metrics to track: 1. Core waste volume growth; 2. Fluctuations in labor and fuel costs; 3. Impact of capital expenditure plans on free cash flow generation.

Watch：Trailing P/E of 30.25 suggests a premium valuation that may limit near-term upside.; Potential slowdown in macroeconomic activity could reduce industrial and commercial waste volumes.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 2.02 美元優於預期的 1.98 美元，營收年增 3.95% 表現穩健。
